name: qsoftware-dashboard-app
description: Native iOS and Android shell for the Q Software Dashboard

scripts.//copy: Day-to-day: rebuild the shell and push it into both native projects. Needs no native toolchain, so it works on a machine with neither Xcode nor the Android SDK.
scripts.//sync: Only needed after adding or removing a Capacitor plugin. Runs pod install, so the iOS half requires full Xcode; use sync:android to skip it.
scripts.sync:android: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.sync:ios: npm run build && cap sync ios
scripts.run:ios: npm run copy && cap run ios
scripts.run:android: npm run copy && cap run android
